text_block_list.text:
We're going to be training differently
than usual
today.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Signature racewear prep is done. All
that's left is
to run.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I wonder how much these clothes will
change the
way I run... Let's hurry up and
try them out.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Ngh... Phew...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Wooow! Brian, you look amazing! Are
you gonna
race in those clothes?!
text_block_list.name: Younger Students

text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Looks like she's ready for a G1
race! Excuse
meee! Over here, over here!
text_block_list.name: Reporters

text_block_list.text: Tch. What a racket.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I thought it would be a good idea to get
her
practicing in her signature racewear
in
preparation for the G1 races, but... it
seems to
have backfired.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: I'll go tell them to ease off.

text_block_list.text: No need. Let's just run.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: I'll shut 'em up!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... Haaah!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Look at that acceleration! We've gotta
get her in
frame somehow!
text_block_list.name: Reporters

text_block_list.text:
Oh my goodness! You can even feel her

determination fro...
text_block_list.name: Younger Students

text_block_list.text: ...From...
text_block_list.name: Younger Students

text_block_list.text:
Phew... How was my time?
...Hello? Snap
out of it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...Heh.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Wearing these clothes really got me
fired up. I
wonder if it's because of the
cleat motif?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
All I can hear when I'm racing is my own

heartbeat... and the breath of my prey
before me.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter if there's a clamor
around me or
someone on my
tail—nothing reaches me.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I'm shutting it all out, stamping it apart
with every
stride.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to the actual race!

text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's go again. I haven't got my fill
yet!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
We should run too! We can't just sit here
staring
after seeing a display like that!
text_block_list.name: Younger Students

text_block_list.text:
Silence your shutters, guys! We want to
capture
her concentrating and running at
her full
potential!
text_block_list.name: Reporters

text_block_list.text:
I see. A mesmerizing run! That could
make for a
good headline!
text_block_list.name: Reporters

text_block_list.text:
Wow... Even when she's fed up, she
looks...
wonderful.
text_block_list.name: Younger Students

text_block_list.text: Tch. I don't need company.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I run alone. The rest of you can laze
about as you
please.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Thanks to her intense focus while
running, Narita
Brian is able to complete
her training calmly.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Everyone quickly apologizes to the
irritated
Нарита Брайан and regains their
focus.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
